column1: The stench of death heralds his coming
Enter with: 40 Gold and a Lucky Claw
The weak drink from the mighty
For your weakness, he blights you
For your sacrilege he taints you
For your pride, he curses you
For your defiance he tests you
Taunt the gods, suffer their wrath
Lord of all, possibly an orange
God of gods, formidable tapper of cubes
He watches from above, thoughts unknowable
His mighty power is fuelled by raw onions
Cast off in haste, it dreams of vengeance
The old is born anew, under his ancient gaze
